To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the spatial structure of methyl-substituted piperidine-4- spiro-5'-imidazolidine -2', 4'-diones is determined by the configuration of the asymmetric carbon atoms in the starting 2-pheny1-piperidine derivatives.
the spatial structures of methyl substituted 4-spiro-piperidine-4-imidazolidine- 2′,4’-diones have a chair-chair conformation and that in these structures the piperidine ring is twisted by about 10°.
The spatial structure of the synthesized compounds was established by the method of X-ray diffraction analysis.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the study of spatial structure of the methyl substituted 2—phenylpiperidin-4—spiro-5’—imidazolidine—2′,4’—diones and with the synthesis of the corresponding compounds with the aim of using them as potential antihypertensive agents.
the development of a new series of spiroheterocyclic compounds with the 2-phenyipiperidine-4- spiro-5′-imida2olidine-2,4′- dione skeleton.

the synthesis of methyl substituted 4-hydroxy-2-phenyl-piperidines and the study of the stereochemical composition and spatial structure by 1H and13NMR spectroscopy of the methyl substituted piperidine-4—spiro-5′-iminazolidine- 2′,4-diones synthesized from them.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
in the case of the compounds under consideration the spatial structure is not determined by the configuration at the carbon atom of the piperidine ring, which is adjacent to the spiro-bridge.

the spatial structure of the 2-phenyipiperidine-4-spriro-5′ -imidazolidine 2′, 44′ -dione series is characterized by the presence of the trans configuration of the substituent in the imidazolidine ring with respect to the piperidine ring, and the cis configuration of the phenyl group with respect to the imidazolide ring.

the spatial structure of the synthesized methyl substituted 2phenylpiperidinespiro-5'-imidazolidine - 2',4'-diones is determined by a combination of the effects of the substituent at the 2-pheny group and the spatial structure of piperidine ring in the starting compounds.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the spatial structure of 2-pheny1piperidine- 4-spiro5′-imidazo1dine2′,4’-diones is characterized by a conformation of the piperidine ring with the transannular bond in the equatorial plane and the imidazole ring in the axial plane.

the spatial structure of methyl-substituted 4-phenylpieridines-4-spirolimidazolidine 2,4-diones is determined by the nature of the substituents on the nitrogen atom and by the position of the methyl substituent in the 2-phenyipiperidine ring.

the spatial structure of 2-pheny1-4-hydroxy-4-methylpiperidine and its 2-phenylethylamine and 2-phenylimidazolidine-4-spirocyclohexanone analogues are identical and that the spatial structures of 2-aryl-4-hydroxpiperidines with different substituents at C(2) and C(4) are identical.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the synthesis of methyl substituted 4-hydroxylpiperidines is a promising approach to obtaining novel biologically active substances.
it is possible to control the stereochemical composition and spatial structure in the synthesis of 2-phenylethyl substituted piperidine-4- spiro-5′- imidazolidine- 2′, 5′- diones.
